## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the concrete issue or diagnostic question and what this change does.

## Validation

List the relevant commands/checks you ran and their outcomes. For technique or
metric changes, describe independent expectations, adverse/neutral cases and
source/provenance checks. Note model, platform or dependency checks not run.

## Scope and compatibility

Link related issues and affected documentation. Explain material limitations or
artifact/configuration compatibility changes. Use synthetic examples; do not
include private documents, credentials or unreviewed report contents.
